summary.whatChanges: Wraps the body of `Doc.indented()` in try/finally so the indent level unwinds even when the callback throws. Previously, a compile error caught higher up (falling back to a runtime island) left the document permanently over-indented, corrupting formatting of all later emitted lines. Adds a test snapshotting the generated code.
behaviorChanges: Compiled/generated code emitted after a thrown-and-caught nested compilation now has correct indentation instead of accumulating extra levels
Debug output of `compileFn(schema, { debug: true }).code` for schemas with islanded sub-schemas (e.g. coerce inside nullable) is formatted consistently
risks: Only whitespace/formatting is affected; any downstream snapshot tests asserting the previously mis-indented output would now fail
The inline snapshot in the new test hardcodes generated code, so unrelated codegen changes will break it
